channel.title: Hermes News Briefing
channel.description: Individual AI, tech, global, US, and India news items generated by Hermes.

item.title: 🇺🇸 US News: US inflation jumps to 3.7%, reviving Fed hike pressure
item.description:
Section: 🇺🇸 US News

September CPI rose 0.6% month over month and 3.7% year over year as gasoline prices surged, while core CPI also came in firmer than expected. Markets marked up odds of tighter Fed policy, with two-year Treasury yields jumping and stocks opening lower. [1]

Sources: [1]

item.title: 🇺🇸 US News: Social Security benefits to rise 3.6% in 2027
item.description:
Section: 🇺🇸 US News

About 76 million Social Security and SSI recipients will receive a 3.6% cost-of-living adjustment, up from 2.8% for 2026. The increase follows the September CPI release and takes effect in January for Social Security recipients. [2]

Sources: [2]

item.title: 🇺🇸 US News: US regulator faults nine big banks over ‘debanking’ practices
item.description:
Section: 🇺🇸 US News

The OCC said the largest national banks maintained policies that could deny or restrict services based on political, religious, social, or lawful-business factors, though it did not announce fines. The report could drive new rules around “reputation risk” and fair access to banking. [3]

Sources: [3]

item.title: 🇺🇸 US News: Six Flags closes nine roller coasters after fatal Georgia accident
item.description:
Section: 🇺🇸 US News

Six Flags temporarily shut similar rides across North America after a man was ejected from the Goliath coaster at Six Flags Over Georgia and died. State regulators and the manufacturer are investigating, putting amusement-ride oversight back in focus. [4]

Sources: [4]

item.title: 📍 Austin / Round Rock TX: Austin airport power outage delays flights, then fully restores service
item.description:
Section: 📍 Austin / Round Rock TX

A partial outage at Austin-Bergstrom’s Barbara Jordan Terminal knocked out some airline ticket counters and forced schedule adjustments Tuesday evening. Airport officials said TSA and baggage claim remained operational and power was fully restored around 8 p.m. [5]

Sources: [5]

item.title: 📍 Austin / Round Rock TX: Austin–San Antonio passenger rail study pegs 125-mph route at $13.5B
item.description:
Section: 📍 Austin / Round Rock TX

A Travis County-commissioned HNTB feasibility study found no major engineering barrier to a roughly 90-mile rail line using SH 130/I-10 corridors and connecting to Austin-Bergstrom. The next questions are ridership, economic impact, operating costs, and whether regional/federal partners will fund it. [6]

Sources: [6]

item.title: 📍 Austin / Round Rock TX: Round Rock ISD tax-rate election would raise average homeowner bills by about $219
item.description:
Section: 📍 Austin / Round Rock TX

A required efficiency audit says the November ballot measure would fund a 2% general staff raise, lift starting teacher pay to $58,000, and address pay compression. The report also found RRISD teacher and administrator pay below peer and state averages. [7]

Sources: [7]

item.title: 📍 Austin / Round Rock TX: Gattis School Road–SH 130 diverging diamond proposed in Round Rock
item.description:
Section: 📍 Austin / Round Rock TX

Transportation planners are considering a diverging diamond interchange at Gattis School Road and SH 130, a design intended to improve left turns and reduce conflict points at busy interchanges. It is one of the more consequential local mobility proposals now moving through the Round Rock-area pipeline. [8]

Sources: [8]

item.title: 🇮🇳 India News: India approves IDBI Bank restructuring tied to ₹52,878 crore Fairfax deal
item.description:
Section: 🇮🇳 India News

The Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs approved a strategic restructuring meant to draw foreign investment, with Fairfax Financial Holdings slated to acquire a 60.72% stake while the government retains a minority position. The transaction advances India’s long-running push to reduce state ownership in banking. [9]

Sources: [9]

item.title: 🇮🇳 India News: India clears ₹53,428 crore social assistance outlay through FY31
item.description:
Section: 🇮🇳 India News

The Union Cabinet approved funding to continue the National Social Assistance Programme from 2026-27 to 2030-31 and revise disability-pension eligibility and benefit norms. The decision matters for low-income elderly, widowed, and disabled beneficiaries as inflation pressures persist. [9]

Sources: [9]

item.title: 🇮🇳 India News: India plans data-center policy as power-use concerns rise
item.description:
Section: 🇮🇳 India News

Economic Times reports India is preparing a data-center policy while officials weigh electricity demand from AI/cloud growth. The move connects industrial policy, grid planning, and India’s ambition to host more AI infrastructure domestically. [10]

Sources: [10]

item.title: 🇮🇳 India News: IMF raises India FY27 growth forecast to 7%
item.description:
Section: 🇮🇳 India News

The IMF lifted its India growth estimate from 6.4% to 7.0%, citing stronger domestic demand and services momentum, while also warning that war-driven oil shocks or an AI-investment pullback could hit global growth. [11]

Sources: [11]

item.title: 🌍 International / World: Ukraine says Starlink restrictions are affecting front-line operations
item.description:
Section: 🌍 International / World

Kyiv said constraints on Elon Musk’s satellite-internet system are hurting front-line operations, including air-defense and drone coordination. The report underscores Ukraine’s dependence on privately controlled communications infrastructure during the war. [12]

Sources: [12]

item.title: 🌍 International / World: Saudi-Houthi escalation widens after Aramco headquarters attack and Sanaa strikes
item.description:
Section: 🌍 International / World

Reuters reported extensive damage at Saudi Aramco’s Dhahran headquarters after a Houthi attack, while Xinhua said Saudi-led coalition strikes hit Houthi-held Sanaa. The escalation is feeding oil-supply risk and broader Gulf security concerns. [13] [14]

Sources: [13] [14]

item.title: 🌍 International / World: Mauritius imposes curfew after worst riots in decades
item.description:
Section: 🌍 International / World

Prime Minister Navin Ramgoolam imposed a curfew after unrest that began over water shortages intensified following a police shooting. The turmoil is a rare major stability shock for Mauritius. [12]

Sources: [12]

item.title: 🌍 International / World: Germany opens trial over Nord Stream pipeline blasts
item.description:
Section: 🌍 International / World

A Ukrainian defendant went on trial in Germany accused of involvement in the 2022 Nord Stream sabotage. The case keeps pressure on a politically sensitive attack that reshaped European energy security. [12]

Sources: [12]

item.title: 🤖 AI & Tech Breakthroughs: Mistral releases Arabic speech-to-text and dialect models
item.description:
Section: 🤖 AI & Tech Breakthroughs

Mistral published Arabic-specific real-time speech-to-text and dialect-classifier models in the MTNRA Hugging Face collection. The release is notable for non-English voice-agent infrastructure and regional language coverage. [15]

Sources: [15]

item.title: 🤖 AI & Tech Breakthroughs: Google begins rolling out Gemini app skills, but delays Workspace launch
item.description:
Section: 🤖 AI & Tech Breakthroughs

Google is rolling out reusable skills in the Gemini app while postponing the separate Workspace version, including sharing and Drive integration. For enterprise users, the delay matters because reusable task instructions are most valuable when they can be shared across teams. [16]

Sources: [16]

item.title: 🤖 AI & Tech Breakthroughs: Developers release tools to capture AI-agent corrections across platforms
item.description:
Section: 🤖 AI & Tech Breakthroughs

Shadowclone and related tooling aim to read coding-agent session histories across Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Pi, and Antigravity, then turn user corrections into reusable skills. This points to a practical “agent memory from corrections” workflow for software teams. [17]

Sources: [17]

item.title: 🤖 AI & Tech Breakthroughs: Codex CLI daemon behavior raises developer security concerns
item.description:
Section: 🤖 AI & Tech Breakthroughs

A widely discussed GitHub issue claims OpenAI’s Codex CLI installs a persistent self-updating background daemon by default. If confirmed and unchanged, the behavior is significant for teams running coding agents on developer machines or private networks. [17]

Sources: [17]

item.title: 💼 Business / Markets: Hot CPI pushes yields and dollar higher while stocks weaken
item.description:
Section: 💼 Business / Markets

Reuters reported the two-year Treasury yield jumped 13 basis points, the 10-year yield rose 9 basis points, the dollar index hit an 18-month high, and gold fell after the inflation report. The market reaction shows energy-driven inflation is now spilling into rate expectations. [1]

Sources: [1]

item.title: 💼 Business / Markets: China exports surge more than 30%, putting trillion-dollar surplus in sight
item.description:
Section: 💼 Business / Markets

Reuters’ Morning Bid said China’s exports rose more than expected on tech-equipment and auto shipments, putting the country on track for another trillion-dollar trade surplus in 2026. The data complicates global trade politics and supports Asian manufacturing sentiment despite weak domestic inflation. [18]

Sources: [18]

item.title: 💼 Business / Markets: Big bank earnings and fixed-income trading weakness pressure financials
item.description:
Section: 💼 Business / Markets

Reuters said US bank stocks stumbled after JPMorgan, Goldman Sachs and others reported unusually large fixed-income trading hits during a volatile quarter. The results are an early warning that higher-rate volatility is affecting even large diversified banks. [18]

Sources: [18]

item.title: 💼 Business / Markets: Oil remains a central inflation risk as Gulf tensions hit supply confidence
item.description:
Section: 💼 Business / Markets

Brent remained around the mid-$100s as traders weighed Houthi-Saudi attacks and damage reports against possible supply offsets. Energy prices are now a direct input into both inflation prints and central-bank expectations. [13] [18]

Sources: [13] [18]

item.title: 🇺🇸 US News: Judge blocks Trump’s White House ban on CNN, MS NOW and Politico
item.description:
Section: 🇺🇸 US News

A federal judge granted a preliminary injunction keeping reporters from the three outlets credentialed while their lawsuit proceeds, finding the ban likely violated First Amendment and due-process rights. The ruling is a major press-access and executive-power case, even though it does not fully restore access to spaces like the Oval Office or Air Force One. [1]

Sources: [1]

item.title: 🇺🇸 US News: Supreme Court will hear DOGE transparency fight
item.description:
Section: 🇺🇸 US News

The Supreme Court agreed to review whether Elon Musk’s Department of Government Efficiency must produce records under FOIA, after lower courts sided with watchdog group CREW. The case could define how much transparency applies to powerful White House-adjacent advisory bodies. [2]

Sources: [2]

item.title: 🇺🇸 US News: Republicans pull back spending in several House battlegrounds
item.description:
Section: 🇺🇸 US News

AP reports the main House GOP super PAC canceled spending in four races while Democrats seek a late $17 million ad push into newly competitive districts. The shift signals a more defensive Republican posture in the final weeks before the Nov. 3 midterms. [3]

Sources: [3]

item.title: 🇺🇸 US News: CBS finds many top Trump meme-coin dinner bidders appear foreign-based
item.description:
Section: 🇺🇸 US News

A CBS News crypto analysis found at least 52 of the top 100 wallets competing for seats at Trump’s next $TRUMP meme-coin dinner used exchanges that bar U.S. customers. The report adds new evidence to foreign-influence and ethics concerns around presidential access-for-crypto contests. [4]

Sources: [4]

item.title: 📍 Austin / Round Rock TX: Austin light rail still needs more than $4B in federal funding
item.description:
Section: 📍 Austin / Round Rock TX

Austin Transit Partnership says it is pursuing Federal Transit Administration New Starts funding to cover about half of the roughly $8.2 billion first light-rail phase, with a grant decision expected in 2027 or possibly 2028. The funding timeline is critical because construction is still targeted for 2027 and trains for the early 2030s. [5]

Sources: [5]

item.title: 📍 Austin / Round Rock TX: Austin ISD parents face deadline that could shape state intervention
item.description:
Section: 📍 Austin / Round Rock TX

Parents at Burnet and Webb middle schools have until Oct. 15 to submit petitions asking the state to close the campuses, an option organizers say could avert a districtwide state takeover after five consecutive failing ratings. The petitions need signatures from more than half of enrolled students’ parents and would affect campus plans for fall 2027. [6]

Sources: [6]

item.title: 📍 Austin / Round Rock TX: Austin weighs oversight changes to ‘No Wrong Door’ homelessness program
item.description:
Section: 📍 Austin / Round Rock TX

City Council members are considering amendments to add community oversight and outcome reporting to the multi-agency program for high-utilization homeless residents. Early city data showed crisis contacts among 99 participants dropped 31%, but legal advocates are pressing for safeguards around policing and data-sharing. [7]

Sources: [7]

item.title: 📍 Austin / Round Rock TX: Austin-based ICON raises $200M to scale 3D-printed construction
item.description:
Section: 📍 Austin / Round Rock TX

ICON secured a $200 million Series D co-led by Baillie Gifford and BlackRock to manufacture and deploy its Titan multi-story construction robot, expand in Texas and other markets, and open a larger Austin R&D facility. The round puts a local hardware/software unicorn at the center of housing-cost and construction-automation bets. [8]

Sources: [8]

item.title: 🇮🇳 India News: India may sharply raise coal-power plans as demand surges
item.description:
Section: 🇮🇳 India News

India’s Central Electricity Authority chief said the country may need 105–150 GW of additional coal capacity beyond earlier plans, citing peak electricity demand running 45–50 GW above last year and hydropower weakness. The comments show India’s AI/cloud and industrial growth colliding with grid-reliability and climate goals. [9]

Sources: [9]

item.title: 🇮🇳 India News: Adani and Jabil sign AI data-center hardware JV framework
item.description:
Section: 🇮🇳 India News

Adani Enterprises and Apple supplier Jabil signed a non-binding MoU for a 50:50 venture to manufacture AI racks, servers, storage, networking, power and cooling equipment in India. The proposed multi-gigawatt platform is tied to India’s projected 5–8 GW data-center capacity by 2030 and Adani’s AI-infrastructure ambitions. [10]

Sources: [10]

item.title: 🇮🇳 India News: Infosys CEO says AI services could become half the company’s work
item.description:
Section: 🇮🇳 India News

Infosys CEO Salil Parekh said AI services, including agents, coding tools and legacy modernization, already exceed 8% of revenue and could reach 20–30% of work within quarters and nearly half within two to three years. That is a concrete signal of how Indian IT services may be restructured around AI delivery. [11]

Sources: [11]

item.title: 🌍 International / World: Houthis launch new Saudi attack as Trump weighs U.S. strikes
item.description:
Section: 🌍 International / World

CBS reported explosions over Riyadh and a Saudi claim that a Houthi ballistic missile was intercepted, while the Houthis vowed more attacks on Saudi airports and oil infrastructure. The escalation raises the chance of deeper U.S. involvement and keeps energy-shipping risk elevated. [12]

Sources: [12]

item.title: 🌍 International / World: Pope Leo XIV diagnosed with lung cancer after surgery
item.description:
Section: 🌍 International / World

The Vatican said Pope Leo underwent successful surgery to remove the lower lobe of his right lung after doctors confirmed lung adenocarcinoma during the procedure. His audiences are canceled through Oct. 20, and the diagnosis could affect near-term Vatican travel and operations. [13]

Sources: [13]

item.title: 🌍 International / World: Ukraine says Kyiv missile strikes came without partner warning
item.description:
Section: 🌍 International / World

Zelenskyy said Ukraine received no early warning from partners before Russian ballistic missiles hit Kyiv; Trump said U.S. intelligence sharing has not stopped, while Ukrainian officials suggested the issue may involve detection of specific weapons. The dispute matters because U.S. early-warning intelligence is central to Ukraine’s air-defense response. [14]

Sources: [14]

item.title: 🌍 International / World: Trump says Greenland oil, gas and mineral exploration is preparing to begin
item.description:
Section: 🌍 International / World

Trump claimed “massive” resource exploration is getting ready in Greenland, weeks after a U.S.-Denmark-Greenland security deal expanded American access and referenced minerals cooperation. The statement could renew tensions with Denmark and Greenland over sovereignty, Arctic resources and U.S. strategic positioning. [15]

Sources: [15]

item.title: 🤖 AI & Tech Breakthroughs: Google launches Gemini 4 Argon with introductory API pricing
item.description:
Section: 🤖 AI & Tech Breakthroughs

Google made Gemini 4 Argon globally available through AI Studio, the Gemini API, Antigravity, the Gemini app and AI Mode, positioning it for coding, finance, legal, cyber and science work. The introductory API price is $2/M input tokens and $10/M output tokens through Nov. 30, with cached inputs discounted 95%. [16]

Sources: [16]

item.title: 🤖 AI & Tech Breakthroughs: Meta introduces Muse Wonder agent models
item.description:
Section: 🤖 AI & Tech Breakthroughs

Meta announced Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full, frontier models aimed at long-running personal and professional agents with Active Memory, Active Focus, coding, computer-use and 1M-token context capabilities. The models are available through the Meta Model API and Muse Code, with the Full version limited to Muse Code subscribers. [17]

Sources: [17]

item.title: 🤖 AI & Tech Breakthroughs: OpenBMB releases MiniCPM-V 4.7 for efficient on-device multimodal AI
item.description:
Section: 🤖 AI & Tech Breakthroughs

OpenBMB published MiniCPM-V 4.7, including a 35B-A3B MoE vision-language model that it says can decode at 13+ tokens/sec on an iPhone 17 Pro Max using about 3 GB of memory. The Apache-2.0 release is notable for on-device multimodal inference, expert scheduling and broad iOS/Android/HarmonyOS deployment support. [18]

Sources: [18]

item.title: 🤖 AI & Tech Breakthroughs: AutoTrust releases JEV-35B decision model on Hugging Face
item.description:
Section: 🤖 AI & Tech Breakthroughs

AutoTrust published JEV-35B, an Apache-2.0 fine-tune of Qwen3.5-35B-A3B designed for fast classification and choice decisions rather than chat generation. The model card reports roughly 3B active parameters per token, 204 ms median latency on a B200, and an NVFP4 version that fits in about 23 GiB of GPU memory. [19]

Sources: [19]

item.title: 💼 Business / Markets: U.S. CPI report expected to show gasoline-driven inflation jump
item.description:
Section: 💼 Business / Markets

Reuters’ preview says September CPI is expected to rise 0.6% month over month and 3.6% year over year, while core inflation is expected at 0.2% month over month and 2.5% year over year. The print is central for Fed policy because markets price only about a 22% chance of another October hike despite higher energy prices. [20]

Sources: [20]

item.title: 💼 Business / Markets: Asian chip stocks rebound ahead of U.S. inflation data
item.description:
Section: 💼 Business / Markets

AI supply-chain names including Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix rose more than 2%, helping Asian shares stabilize after a selloff. The bounce suggests investors are still buying semiconductor exposure, but oil prices and the CPI release are limiting risk appetite. [21]

Sources: [21]

item.title: 💼 Business / Markets: Oil holds near $106 as Saudi-Houthi risk offsets Russian diesel supply hopes
item.description:
Section: 💼 Business / Markets

Brent traded around $106.58 and WTI around $94.94 as traders weighed Houthi-Saudi fighting and an Aramco building attack against expectations of more Russian diesel exports. The move keeps energy prices a live inflation and market-risk input. [22]

Sources: [22]

item.title: 🇺🇸 US News: Six Flags closes nine roller coasters after fatal Georgia fall
item.description:
Section: 🇺🇸 US News

Six Flags shut nine North American coasters after a man fell to his death from the Georgia Scorcher while families watched, triggering manufacturer and company investigations. The closures matter because they affect multiple parks and raise broader amusement-ride safety scrutiny. [1]

Sources: [1]

item.title: 🇺🇸 US News: Cornell bans fraternity parties after gang-rape allegation
item.description:
Section: 🇺🇸 US News

Cornell suspended fraternity parties and gave New York State Police a role in investigating campus assault reports after a reported gang rape. The move signals escalating pressure on universities over Greek life, alcohol culture, and sexual-violence response. [2]

Sources: [2]

item.title: 🇺🇸 US News: AP-NORC poll finds broad concern over Trump profiting from presidency
item.description:
Section: 🇺🇸 US News

An AP-NORC poll found many Americans think President Trump is illegally or unethically profiting from office, including through family crypto interests. The result keeps ethics and conflicts-of-interest issues central ahead of the midterms. [3]

Sources: [3]

item.title: 📍 Austin / Round Rock TX: Austin airport power outage delays flights, then normal operations resume
item.description:
Section: 📍 Austin / Round Rock TX

A partial outage in AUS’s Barbara Jordan Terminal disrupted ticket counters for Southwest, United and Delta and caused flight delays before most systems returned by evening. The incident matters for local travel reliability as AUS continues major expansion work. [4]

Sources: [4]

item.title: 📍 Austin / Round Rock TX: TxDOT advances SH 130–Gattis School diverging-diamond plan near Round Rock
item.description:
Section: 📍 Austin / Round Rock TX

TxDOT is proposing a $22 million diverging diamond interchange, bypass lanes and ramp reconstruction at SH 130 and Gattis School Road, with construction expected in late 2027 after environmental/design work. The project targets safety and congestion in a fast-growing Round Rock/Hutto/Pflugerville corridor. [5] [6]

Sources: [5] [6]

item.title: 📍 Austin / Round Rock TX: Austin’s FY 2026-27 property-tax rate raises city revenue 7.4%
item.description:
Section: 📍 Austin / Round Rock TX

City budget documents show Austin’s adopted property-tax rate at $0.579948 per $100 taxable value, raising $89.3 million more than last year. That is a material household-budget and city-services item for Austin property owners. [7]

Sources: [7]

item.title: 🇮🇳 India News: India plans data-center policy as AI/cloud power demand draws backlash
item.description:
Section: 🇮🇳 India News

India’s junior IT minister said the government is preparing a dedicated data-center policy to prevent rising electricity demand from pushing up consumer bills. The move follows protests over planned Amazon and Google facilities and shows AI infrastructure becoming an energy-policy issue. [8]

Sources: [8]

item.title: 🇮🇳 India News: India’s youth-led ‘Cockroach’ protest leaders jailed for five days
item.description:
Section: 🇮🇳 India News

A court ordered two Cockroach Janta Party leaders detained after they entered Delhi’s Jantar Mantar protest site demanding the election chief’s resignation. Reuters says the detentions could trigger fresh protests amid controversy over voter-list revisions. [9]

Sources: [9]

item.title: 🌍 International / World: Houthis vow more Saudi oil and airport attacks after Aramco HQ hit
item.description:
Section: 🌍 International / World

Yemen’s Houthis said they would continue attacks on Saudi airports and oil facilities after an attack on Saudi Aramco’s Dhahran headquarters caused a fire and damage but no reported deaths. The escalation raises energy-market and regional-security risk. [10]

Sources: [10]

item.title: 🌍 International / World: Container ship carrying 2,500 containers sinks near Strait of Hormuz
item.description:
Section: 🌍 International / World

Iran’s Revolutionary Guards Navy said a container ship sank south of Hormuz after hitting a naval mine and catching fire. The incident adds to concerns over one of the world’s most important oil and LNG transit chokepoints. [11]

Sources: [11]

item.title: 🌍 International / World: Zelenskyy says Ukraine received no partner warning before missiles hit Kyiv
item.description:
Section: 🌍 International / World

AP’s top world coverage highlights Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy saying Kyiv received no intelligence from partners about incoming missiles. The claim matters for air-defense coordination as Russia’s strikes continue. [12]

Sources: [12]

item.title: 🤖 AI & Tech Breakthroughs: Reflection previews Beam, a 501B open-weight coding and agent model
item.description:
Section: 🤖 AI & Tech Breakthroughs

Reflection introduced Beam, a sparse MoE model with 501B total parameters and 23B active, aimed at coding, reasoning and agentic workloads. The company says it will release weights under Apache 2.0 later this month, making it one of the more notable Western open-weight model pushes. [13]

Sources: [13]

item.title: 🤖 AI & Tech Breakthroughs: Google launches Gemini agent for enterprise work orchestration
item.description:
Section: 🤖 AI & Tech Breakthroughs

Google Cloud introduced Gemini agent as a single work agent spanning Workspace, code, data analysis, persistent execution, controls and multi-model cost routing. The announcement is notable because Google is packaging agentic AI as an enterprise operating layer rather than a standalone chatbot. [14]

Sources: [14]

item.title: 🤖 AI & Tech Breakthroughs: Kamala Harris warns AI guardrail window is closing
item.description:
Section: 🤖 AI & Tech Breakthroughs

Former Vice President Kamala Harris urged governments and AI companies to move faster on safeguards for cybersecurity threats, AI-enabled weapons and loss of human control, while calling for U.S.-China cooperation on standards. The comments reflect rising political focus on frontier AI governance. [15]

Sources: [15]

item.title: 🤖 AI & Tech Breakthroughs: Kroger cuts 3,000 corporate jobs as AI reshapes operations
item.description:
Section: 🤖 AI & Tech Breakthroughs

Kroger said it will cut 3,000 corporate roles while investing in AI and automation. The layoffs are an early large-scale retail example of AI being tied directly to white-collar restructuring. [16]

Sources: [16]

item.description:

item.title: 💼 Business / Markets: Markets brace for U.S. CPI as chip stocks stabilize
item.description:
Section: 💼 Business / Markets

Asian shares rose as AI-linked chipmakers rebounded, but investors stayed cautious ahead of U.S. inflation data, with oil prices and possible Fed hikes in focus. The setup matters because inflation surprises could move rates, tech valuations and global risk appetite. [18]

item.description:

item.title: 🇮🇳 India News: India sketches long-term critical-tech resilience plan
item.description:

item.description:
Section: 🌍 International / World
